recipe.visualDefinition: A high-angle aerial view of a lush green field where hundreds of tiny human figures are arranged to form a large-scale portrait of a face. To the right, a figure operates a lawnmower, leaving behind text carved into the grass as if mown into the turf.
coreVisualRelationships: Scale contrast between individual tiny figures and the massive portrait they compose
Textural contrast between the organic grass and the dark clothing of the crowd
Narrative link between the lawnmower figure and the mown-grass typography
Diagonal orientation of the portrait relative to the square frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The human-formed portrait occupies the central 70% of the frame, tilted at a 45-degree angle.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark, dense clusters of people forming the hair and facial features.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large central face, moves to the lawnmower figure in the top right, and follows the mown text downward.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive green grass surrounding the central formation, providing breathing room for the complex detail.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark silhouettes/black clothing (defining the portrait features)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale yellow/tan (mown grass text) and small white highlights (sparkles/jewelry on figures)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation green with high contrast between the dark figures and the bright field.

letterConstructionRules: Letters appear as if mown into tall grass
Variable thickness based on mower path
Rough, organic edges consistent with cut turf
Lighter tan/yellow color representing the exposed dry grass or soil beneath
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The organic mown script contrasts with the rigid, pixel-like arrangement of the human crowd.
graphicDevices: Sparkle effects on specific crowd members

candidateDirections.reason: Mimics the fluid motion of a lawnmower path
Best for achieving the recessed turf look

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create an aerial view of a vibrant green grass field with a large crowd of tiny people arranged to form a human face. Include a small figure with a lawnmower in the upper right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add cursive text along the right side that looks like it has been mown into the grass, using a tan, fibrous texture that appears slightly recessed into the turf.

verificationChecks: Text looks like a physical part of the grass
Crowd figures are small enough to look like pixels from a distance
Portrait is recognizable but composed entirely of individuals
Lighting is consistent across the field and figures

mustAchieve: Consistent shadow direction for all tiny figures
avoid: Floating text that doesn't interact with the ground

postGenerationChecks: Does the crowd formation accurately depict a face?
Is the scale difference between the mower and the field believable?
Does the mown text have a realistic depth and color?
Are the shadows of the people consistent with a single light source?
recipe.reuseFormula: Aerial landscape + human-pixel mosaic + environmental typography
